verified: Three checking helpers differ only by specified round/base substitutions.

Fresh verification keeps single-main clone, absent topic object, immutable annotated tag, exact synthetic/merged tree and sole trusted parent checks, strict record/history/native review checks and exact current hash coverage.
Only additional verification change removes repeated postmerge full suite; source checkout operations remain read-only.
Sync retains snapshot equality, ignored/nontracked collision checks, immutable tag, exact merged tree/sole parent, fast-forward-only update and post-update preservation checks.
Local full suite remains required by final-gates and new sync guard; full command status and log digest checked.
limitations: Static assurance only; actual final package, committed identity, CI, queue, cleanup and postmerge receipts remain runtime prerequisites.

The new sync local-gate check verifies success and log integrity but does not itself compare gate base/worktree or record input hashes to the reviewed commit. Final package/commit audit must establish that provenance; this review does not claim exact-tree full-suite binding from sync alone.
Coverage helper supplements canonical review validation; its positive-review hash matching is not a replacement for finding-lineage validation.
Count configuration is provisional and must be rebound to actual final census.
Source comparison and AST parsing do not prove behavior at runtime.
